title: Owens' three UFO sightings and the Sonoma State UFO
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Owens' three UFO sightings and the Sonoma State UFO, about 1976 at Sonoma State College, Rohnert Park, California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm going to create three UFO sightings within a 90-day period within a 100 miles of San Francisco.
